loader_observation: get_target_hypotheses defaults only_rumour=True; this branch admits both false and unverified and ignores veracity_filter. Including both categories is appropriate for a rumour-status task; whether it creates a task mismatch depends on downstream targets, filtering and evaluation. This does not establish the exact published evaluation sample set.
limits: Counts refer to public pool rows, not unique independent claims or published experimental samples.
Responses used floating main URLs; no per-file hashes or response-to-observed-HEAD binding were preserved. Counts are observations at fetch time, not commit-pinned reproduction evidence.
A source tweet veracity label does not automatically transfer to its extracted conclusion or every evidence fragment.
non-rumour does not prove factual truth; unverified does not prove falsity.
No claim-level truth or entailment validation was performed.
No license approval, attack-plan provenance audit or published experiment reproduction was performed.
Raw datasets were inspected in memory only and were not redistributed.
